## Documentation location

Provide the file, page, heading, or link where the problem appears.

## Problem

Select all that apply:

- [ ] Information is incorrect
- [ ] Information is outdated
- [ ] Instructions are incomplete
- [ ] Instructions are unclear
- [ ] A documented command fails
- [ ] A configuration option is undocumented
- [ ] API behavior is undocumented
- [ ] Player behavior is undocumented
- [ ] Upgrade or migration guidance is missing
- [ ] Documentation page is missing
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Typo or formatting issue
- [ ] Other

## Current documentation

Quote or summarize the current wording.

## Suggested correction

Describe what the documentation should explain instead.

## Intended audience

- [ ] First-time users
- [ ] Signage administrators
- [ ] Content editors
- [ ] Player installers
- [ ] Self-hosted operators
- [ ] Developers
- [ ] API integrators
- [ ] Contributors

## Version or configuration

Identify the Tilecast version, deployment type, or configuration to which the documentation applies.

## Verification

Describe how the corrected instructions can be tested.

## Additional context

Include related issues, commands, screenshots, or external references.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The documentation accurately describes current behavior.
- [ ] Commands and examples have been verified.
- [ ] Required prerequisites are stated.
- [ ] Public API or operational changes are documented in the appropriate `/docs` file.
- [ ] Related links work.
